title: Microsoft Stock (MSFT) Rises 0.2% to $523.88 (Nov 13)
summary: Microsoft stock (MSFT) rose 0.17% to $523.88 on Nov. 13 as the Nasdaq fell 0.91%, after an Outlook and Teams outage weighed on shares premarket.
body_markdown:
## Why Microsoft Stock Rose


Financial media did not tie Microsoft's closing gain to a specific company announcement, and the session's main company news was a service outage that weighed on the shares before the open.


According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) , Microsoft shares were 3% lower in premarket trade at 4:35 a.m. ET as an Outlook outage disrupted businesses, governments and the public worldwide. CNBC reported the shares were still down more than 1% at 6:28 a.m. ET.


The wider selling fell on chipmakers. CNBC tied the Nasdaq's decline to an Nvidia sell-off after[Jensen Huang exited as Nvidia CEO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-13-2026/) , and reported that Apple reached an intraday all-time high as investors sought safety from the AI sell-off. CNBC did not name a reason for Microsoft's recovery from its early losses.


Company events fill the coming week. Microsoft's Ignite conference runs Nov. 17 to Nov. 20 at the Moscone Center in San Francisco, with CEO Satya Nadella giving the opening keynote, according to[the Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-ignite-starts-nov-17-140301014.html) . As reported by[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/morgan-stanley-doubles-down-microsoft-173300820.html) , Morgan Stanley has a meeting scheduled with CFO Amy Hood and investor relations on Nov. 18.


## MSFT Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Revenue growth: in its fiscal first-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on Oct. 28, Microsoft reported revenue of $92.3 billion, up 19%, and net income of $36.6 billion, up 32%, according to[the company's release](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2027-q1/press-release-webcast) .
- Cloud momentum: Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 30% to $63.9 billion and Azure revenue grew 48%, per the same release.
- Copilot usage: daily Copilot users rose almost 50% from the prior quarter, and customers with more than 50,000 Copilot seats grew more than eightfold year over year, the Motley Fool reported.


### Risks


- AI spending: capital expenditure doubled to $39 billion in the quarter for AI data center capacity, TheStreet reported, and Morgan Stanley flagged Microsoft's Maia custom chip as a margin variable.
- Copilot monetization: Microsoft last disclosed more than 30 million paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats in July and gave no count in October, per the Motley Fool.
- Higher rates: the 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.15%, and CNBC reported that investors see a Federal Reserve rate hike next month as a near certainty.


TheStreet lists Jan. 27, 2027 as the projected, unconfirmed date for Microsoft's fiscal second-quarter report.
